title: SMP Trip - National Museum of the Marine Corps
intro: Visit the National Museum of the Marine Corps and experience the Museum with your fellow Marines.

sections.markdown:
The National Museum of the Marine Corps, under the command of Marine Corps University, preserves and exhibits the material history of the U.S. Marine Corps; honors the commitment, accomplishments, and sacrifices of Marines; supports recruitment, training, education, and retention of Marines; and provides the public with a readily accessible platform for the exploration of Marine Corps history.

[Register on Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/o/12631456557)

**SMP Transportation Pick up locations and Times:**

- 09:00 AM - MSRC (Main Side Rec Center 206 Nicholas Rd, Quantico, VA)
- 9:10 AM - OCS Taxi
- 9:15 AM - HMX-1/MCAF Gate
- 9:20 AM - MCESG/WTBN Chow Hall

Transportation is only provided to Single Service Members and geo-bachelors associated with the SMP. Seating limited; first come, first served.

For more information call [703.432.0363](tel:703.432.0363) or Email: [MCCSQUANTICOSMP@USMC-MCCS.ORG](mailto:MCCSQUANTICOSMP@USMC-MCCS.ORG)
